text: Across the four m2-fixed seeds (20-23), the N=64 to N=128 trained force R2 drop is about 0.07-0.14. When N=64 seeds 22-23 are read at the checkpoint whose val_mse_ratio matches N=128 step 3000 (0.053-0.062), is the drop still 0.05 or more? If not, the m2-fixed force loss at N=128 is slower convergence rather than a ceiling.
